name: item-settings-panel
title: Item: Settings Panel
description: Use `ItemGroup variant="panel"` for a shared panel surface. Each `Item` supplies the row layout, while `ItemSeparator` provides inset dividers. Controls belong in `ItemActions` and need accessible labels.
